strings.seo.faq[1].a: Leai. E leai se resitala, e leai se tuatusi imeli: e mafai ona e fa'aaogaina meafaigaluega i le taimi lava lena.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Leai. O au faila e fa'aaogaina na o le galuega na e talosagaina, ona tape lea. E leai se tasi e faitauina ma e le mafai lava ona fa'asoa.

strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ioe. E galue le pdff i le upega tafa'ilagi o so'o se telefoni, papalama po'o le komepiuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), e leai se mea e mana'omia ona fa'apipi'i.

strings.privacy.title: Fa'alilolilo
strings.privacy.description: Le fa'atautaiga a le pdff i au faila: e leai se teugatupe, e leai se pepa e taofia, e leai ni fa'asalalauga ma e leai se fa'atau atu o fa'amatalaga.
strings.privacy.intro: Ua faia le pdff ina ia tumau pea au pepa ia te oe. O iinei, i upu manino, le mea e tupu pe a e fa'aaogaina.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Au faila
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: E lafo ma puipuia (HTTPS), fa'agaioi otometi, ona tape lea pe a mae'a ona sauni le taunu'uga. O faila tetele e ui atu i le teuina le tumau i lalo o se igoa fa'afuase'i ma e tape pe a uma le fa'agaioiga; e tapeina otometi e le fa'amama so'o se mea e ono totoe i totonu o le 24 itula.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: E leai se teugatupe, e leai ni fa'amatalaga patino
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: E le fesili le pdff mo se resitala, tuatusi imeli po'o se kata aitalafu. E le mafai lava ona faitauina, su'esu'eina, fa'asoa pe fa'aaogaina au pepa e a'oa'o ai le mafaufau fa'akomepiuta (AI).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Fua o tagata asiasi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Matou te faitauina asiasiga e aunoa ma le fa'ailoaina o lou suafa ma e aunoa ma ni kuki (Vercel Web Analytics) e su'esu'e po'o fea meafaigaluega e aoga. E leai ni fa'asalalauga, e leai se siakiina i isi upega tafa'ilagi.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kuki
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: E na o le tasi le kuki filifilia: e manatua le gagana na e filifilia.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Talimalo
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: O le upega tafa'ilagi e talimalo ai le Vercel i luga o 'au'aunaga i Pale; o liliuga o le Word, Excel ma le PowerPoint e fa'atautaia e le Render i Frankfurt. O nei kamupani e na'o le taulimaina o faila mo le taimi o le liliuga.

strings.legal.security.title: Security and data
strings.legal.security.description: What happens to your files on pdff: automatic processing, no analysis, immediate deletion, encryption, hosting in Europe, and the option to install it on your own servers.
strings.legal.security.intro: What happens to your files, where they are processed and how they are protected: explained simply, for individuals and IT departments alike.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: No documents kept
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Your files are processed automatically, then deleted as soon as the result is ready or downloaded. There is no copy, no backup and no history. A daily automatic cleanup also erases any temporary file that might remain, by the next day at the latest.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: No analysis
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Nobody reads your documents. They are not indexed, analyzed, shared or used to train artificial intelligence. pdff has no accounts, no ads and no user profiles.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Encryption
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Every connection is encrypted (HTTPS) and the site enforces encryption on every visit (HSTS). The Protect tool encrypts your PDFs with AES-256; the password you choose is never stored.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Where your files are processed
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Site, PDF and image tools: Vercel, Paris data center (France, European Union). Word, Excel and PowerPoint conversions: Render, in Frankfurt (Germany, European Union). Files over 4 MB: temporary Vercel Blob storage, under a random name, deleted after use.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Technical safeguards
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Security headers (HSTS, blocking the site from being embedded in other pages, protection against file-type confusion), temporary file addresses that cannot be guessed, and a conversion service that only accepts requests carrying a secret token. Every code change is checked automatically (tests, type checks) before going live.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Privacy and applicable law
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff is published in New Brunswick and complies with Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). It collects no personal information about its users: no account, no email address, no tracking cookie. It is built on the same principles as the European GDPR and Quebec's Law 25: data minimization, no reuse, deletion after processing.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: For organizations with strict rules
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: If your rules forbid sending documents to an outside service, install pdff on your own servers. The complete software is free, open source and works without an Internet connection: no file ever leaves your network. The installation guide is on the project page.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Transparency
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: The complete source code is public: your security teams can verify every one of these statements.

strings.legal.accessibility.title: Accessibility
strings.legal.accessibility.description: pdff accessibility statement: WCAG 2.2 level AA target, measures in place, known limitations and how to report a barrier.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Everyone must be able to use pdff, including people who are blind or have low vision, who are Deaf or hard of hearing, or who have a motor or cognitive disability.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Target standard
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff aims to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA, the international W3C standard. This level covers the requirements of the Government of Canada's Standard on Web Accessibility, the European standard EN 301 549 and Section 508 in the United States, which refer to WCAG 2.0 or 2.1 level AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Conformance status
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff is partially conformant with WCAG 2.2 level AA: known limitations are listed below. This statement is based on an internal evaluation carried out on October 2, 2026, using automated tools (axe, Lighthouse) and manual checks (keyboard, contrast, zoom, announcements). No independent audit has been carried out yet.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: What is in place
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: The whole site works with a keyboard, with a “Skip to content” link and a visible outline on the active element. Text contrast is at least 4.5:1. The steps of a task (upload, result, error) are announced to screen readers. File order can be changed without drag and drop, using buttons. The site follows your device's “reduce motion” setting: animations then stop completely. Pages remain readable at 400% zoom and on mobile. The language of each page is declared, and Arabic is displayed right to left.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Known limitations
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Without that setting, decorative animations (background, ring, format ticker) run continuously; the ticker pauses on hover and keyboard focus. The animated ring on the home page is operated with a mouse or a finger; it is decorative, and the list of formats it shows is also available as text on the page. Machine-translated languages may contain inaccuracies. Finally, the accessibility of a produced document depends on the original: pdff does not add accessibility tags to a PDF that has none.

strings.tools.ocr.name: Faitau se su'esu'ega
strings.tools.ocr.tagline: Fiafia i le tusitusiga o se pepa na su'esu'eina po'o le pu'eina e mafai ona su'esu'e ma kopi.
strings.tools.ocr.seoTitle: OCR fua i luga ole laiga: fai se PDF su'esu'eina e mafai ona su'esu'e
strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Faitau le tusitusiga o se PDF po'o se ata su'esu'eina (OCR) ina ia mafai ona e su'esu'e, kopi pe fa'alogoina. 16 gagana, fua, e le o lafoina le pepa.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: O se pepa na su'esu'eina po'o le pu'eina na o se ata: e le mafai ona e su'esu'e mo se upu po'o le kopiina o se fuaiupu. Faitau se su'esu'ega e iloa ai mataitusi ta'itasi (e ta'ua lea o le OCR) ma fa'aopopo le tusitusiga moni i le pepa e aunoa ma le suia o ona foliga. E faia le faitau i lau masini: e le o lafoina lau pepa. Na'o le fa'ata'ita'iga mo le gagana na filifilia (nai MB) e la'u mai tasi.

strings.tools.ocr.guide.faq[0].a: Iloa mataitusi vaaia: e iloa e le komepiuta mataitusi i se ata e liliu ai i tusitusiga moni.

strings.tools.remplir.name: Fa'atumu se pepa
strings.tools.remplir.tagline: Fa'atumu se pepa PDF sa'o i lau su'esu'ega.
strings.tools.remplir.seoTitle: Fa'atumu se pepa PDF i luga ole laiga mo le leai se totogi
strings.tools.remplir.seoDescription: Fa'atumu vaega o se pepa PDF (tusitusiga, pusa siaki, lisi) e aunoa ma se polokalama, ona la'u mai lea ua fa'atumu, loka pe afai e te mana'o ai. Fua, e leai se saini.
strings.tools.remplir.intro: Tu'u se pepa PDF: e maua e le pdff vaega ta'itasi ma fa'aalia e pei o se pepa faigofie. Fa'atumu, siaki le va'aiga muamua, ona kiliki lea o le Fa'atumu se pepa e la'u mai ai le PDF ua mae'a.

strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[0].a: O le PDF e le o se pepa feso'ota'i (e masani lava o se su'esu'ega). E tatau ona e lolomia pe talosaga i le fa'alapotopotoga mo se fa' वर्जन feso'ota'i.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[1].q: O le a le mea e fai e le "Loka tali"?
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[1].a: O tali e avea ma vaega o le itulau ma e le toe mafai ona suia.
strings.tools.comparer.name: Fa'atusatusa
strings.tools.comparer.tagline: Va'ai po'o le a le suiga i le va o fa' ورژن e lua o se PDF.

strings.tools.comparer.seoDescription: Fa'atusatusa fa' ورژن e lua o se konekarate po'o se pepa PDF: upu fa'aopopo i le lanumeamata, upu aveese i le lanumumu, ma se lipoti e mafai ona la'u mai. Fua, e leai se mea e la'uina.
strings.tools.comparer.intro: Tu'u le fa' ورژن tuai, ona sosoo ai lea ma le mea fou: e fa'aalia fa'afuase'i eseesega, upu i upu. Kiliki Fa'atusatusa e la'u mai ai le lipoti. O mea uma e tupu i lau su'esu'ega.

strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].title: Faitau eseesega

strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].a: Ioe, pe a uma ona fa'aoga i le meafaigaluega Faitau se su'esu'ega, lea e aveesea ai a latou tusitusiga.
